title: Concept: Recovery code list in a response
description: An array of account recovery codes in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Recovery codes bypass the second factor, so returning the whole list hands over a durable way into the account that survives a password change.
applicability: Deployments that render an array of account recovery codes into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: Recovery codes bypass the second factor, so returning the whole list hands over a durable way into the account that survives a password change.
